title: NTRUHS alleges misinformation over seat allocation to reserved category students
description: By the end of three rounds of counselling for MBBS admissions for 2026–27 academic year, 3,543 seats, accounting for 77.34%, of the 4,581 convener quota seats have been allotted to students belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Backward Classes, says Registrar
